description: This file provides functions and types for managing Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI resources, including listing resources, deployments, prompting user input, testing connections, and handling tenant authentication.

methods.name: listFoundryResources
methods.description: Lists Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI resources in a subscription, filtering by resource group and kind.

methods.name: listResourceDeployments
methods.description: Lists deployments for a given resource, filtering for successful ones.

methods.name: buildCreateFoundryHint
methods.description: Generates a message prompting the user to create Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI resources.

methods.name: selectFoundryResource
methods.description: Prompts the user to select an Azure AI Foundry or OpenAI resource from available options.

methods.name: selectFoundryDeployment
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a deployment for a given resource.

methods.name: promptEndpointAndModelManually
methods.description: Prompts the user to manually input Foundry endpoint URL and model name.

methods.name: promptApiKeyEndpointAndModel
methods.description: Prompts the user to input Foundry endpoint URL and model name with environment variable default.

methods.name: buildFoundryConnectionTest
methods.description: Builds a test request for checking the connection to a Foundry endpoint.

methods.name: extractTenantSuggestions
methods.description: Extracts tenant ID and label suggestions from a raw message string.

methods.name: isValidTenantIdentifier
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid tenant ID (UUID or domain).

methods.name: promptTenantId
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a tenant ID, with validation and suggestions.

methods.name: loginWithTenantFallback
methods.description: Attempts login with device code, prompts for tenant ID if needed, and retries login with tenant scope.

methods.name: testFoundryConnection
methods.description: Performs a connection test to a Foundry endpoint and reports success or failure.
